description: archivist/messages.json: the words of the Archivist's own refusals, and of the messages it logs that a reader relies on.

boot.description: Each refusal to start of the Archivist's own, written in service-environment/boot-refusals.json's `line`.

situation.description: When it is written, and what fills each `{name}` of its text.

refusal.description: The refusal, in place of the line's `{refusal}`. A `{name}` in it is filled with what the row's `situation` names, and nothing else in it varies.

unsent.description: The failure a reply that cannot be sent is answered with instead, on the operation's failure channel.

situation.description: When it is written, and what fills each `{name}` of its text.

message.description: The failure's `message`. A `{name}` in it is filled with what the row's `situation` names, and nothing else in it varies.

refusals.description: Each refusal of an operation, on the operation's failure channel.

operations.description: The operations it refuses: requests of bus/registry.json's operations that the Archivist answers. `{channel}` in the message is the one refused.

situation.description: When it is written, and what fills each `{name}` of its text.

message.description: The failure's `message`. A `{name}` in it is filled with what the row's `situation` names, and nothing else in it varies.

unauthorized.description: The refusal of every route of the HTTP surface but `/health`: a token that is missing, or not of the knowledge base's issuer and audience, or without the service role.

presented.description: The `WWW-Authenticate` header when a token was presented.

http.description: Each other error a route of the HTTP surface answers with.

route.description: The route, as the Archivist's API names its path.

code.description: The body's `code`, where it carries one.

situation.description: When it is written, and what fills each `{name}` of its text.

error.description: The body's `error`. A `{name}` in it is filled with what the row's `situation` names, and nothing else in it varies.

logged.description: Each message the Archivist logs that a reader of its output relies on.

situation.description: When it is written, and what fills each `{name}` of its text.

message.description: The line's message, word for word.

fields.description: The fields the line is logged with whose form is stated, by name: each a text whose `{name}` is filled as the row's `situation` says. The line may carry others.

additionalProperties.description: The field's value. A `{name}` in it is filled with what the row's `situation` names, and nothing else in it varies.
